dialog: Ever since the stars disappeared, no one looks for them...
name: EXT. PRADERA - NOCHE 1

dialog: Or maybe they left because no one was looking for them?
name: EXT. PRADERA - NOCHE 2

dialog: Before your journey begins, the Divinity must reveal who you truly are.
name: INT. LIMBO - DÍA [MysticQuestioning] 1

dialog: You wake up... Good. But before the light touches your skin, the Divinity must see you.
name: INT. LIMBO - DÍA [MysticQuestioning] 2

dialog: Three gifts are offered to you. One hums with power, another oozes warmth, and the last one shines with thought. Which do you choose?
name: INT. LIMBO - DÍA [MysticQuestioning] 3

dialog: So it is written. Walk the path of the [TYPE], but keep your spirit of self-improvement, for only then will you be able to visit all the paths.
name: INT. LIMBO - DÍA [MysticQuestioning] 4

dialog: Huh...?
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 1

dialog: Hey! Easy, easy! Don't try to move yet!
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 2

dialog: Looks like you're just about to Awaken...
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 3

dialog: Alright, follow my voice. Take a deep breath.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 4

dialog: Feel the noise and the silence. Feel what you pretend to be and what you really are.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 5

dialog: Think about everything that stands between those images.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 6

dialog: Think about what hurt, and what you kept quiet. About the obstacles they put in your way, and all the times you yourself threw yourself into the void.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 7

dialog: Think about your actions and their consequences.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 8

dialog: And now... Wake up.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 9

dialog: Finally! For a moment I thought you wouldn't make it.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 10

dialog: What happened?
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 11

dialog: You just Awakened.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 12

dialog: Long ago, in some past life, you were consumed by temptations that left you a hollow shell.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 13

dialog: You wandered aimlessly for countless years, but at some point you rejected that shell and freed your soul.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 14

dialog: Thanks to that, "you dwell in the here and now." You triumphed for the first time.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 15

dialog: "I must congratulate you, for many are unable to achieve such a feat."
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 16

dialog: Though it's obvious that without the help of the great Liria you wouldn't have been able to do it.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 17

dialog: Who are you?
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 18

dialog: So impatient... I help you Awaken and the first thing you do is interrogate me?
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 19

dialog: Ugh... Who have I helped?
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 20

dialog: I'm Liria, a guiding spirit.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 21

dialog: My mission is to guide here the souls of those who renounce their shells and shackles.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 22

dialog: Without me, those souls would scatter through limbo and never find their way to this place.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 23

dialog: Though sometimes it's hard to get their attention... And you didn't make it easy.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 24

dialog: You were lucky to come across such a good guide.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 25

dialog: Where am I?
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 26

dialog: You're at the Source, the place where souls like yours are reborn from their ashes. The origin of all creation.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 27

dialog: Beneath our feet lies a well of infinite souls that wander without direction.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 28

dialog: Empty shells, just like you once were.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 29

dialog: Luckily, you had the courage to renounce your armor and free your soul.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 30

dialog: And the luck of meeting the great Liria, of course.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 31

dialog: Anyway, I know you probably have many questions, but right now we need to move.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 32

dialog: Just as we managed to bring your soul back here, other spirits and creatures could do the same.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 33

dialog: Let's head into that forest and find somewhere to rest before night falls.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 34

dialog: After that, we'll have time to catch up.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 35

dialog: Wow, you look awful...
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 36

dialog: But we can't stay here.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 37

dialog: Come on, let's go to the forest. This time I'll lend you my life energy.
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 38

dialog: But don't get used to it, okay?
name: EXT. FUENTE - DÍA 39

dialog: Alright, looks like we're safe here.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 1

dialog: And you're getting some color back, too.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 2

dialog: Let's see...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 3

dialog: So your name is NAME...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 4

dialog: I don't think we can stay around here much longer, but at least we can catch our breath.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 5

dialog: May I ask how you're feeling?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 6

dialog: I'm fine, thanks.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 7

dialog: I see. I'm glad I didn't rescue some lazybones.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 8

dialog: I've got quite the eye... Anyway...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 9

dialog: I've been better, I won't lie to you.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 10

dialog: Oh! Please, accept my apologies for such haste.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 11

dialog: Sometimes I forget how soft you humans are...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 12

dialog: I mean... that I need to be more considerate!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 13

dialog: Yes, that, that... Anyway...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 14

dialog: I think all this movement makes me nauseous...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 15

dialog: Ugh! You didn't have to give me that many details!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 16

dialog: Well, I'm sure a bit of rest will do you good. Sit down and take a deep breath, we're not in a rush.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 17

dialog: Well, I'm sure a bit of rest will do you wonders.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 18

dialog: Do you have any questions I can answer?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 19

dialog: What is this world?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 20

dialog: Well... I don't think that question has a trivial answer, exactly.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 21

dialog: But I'll do what I can not to ramble too much!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 22

dialog: You're in the Realms of Being, a harmonious land created by the Divinity so that we may heal and grow.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 23

dialog: A land designed for joy, discipline, and care—both within and beyond oneself...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 24

dialog: ...But which ended up being corrupted and fragmented by...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 25

dialog: How did I get to this world?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 26

dialog: Well, truthfully you've always been part of it.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 27

dialog: Until a few moments ago, you were a soul; a shell.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 28

dialog: Like all those who wander the depths, beneath this very ground.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 29

dialog: However, you received the call. You followed it, and now you're part of the earthly plane of the Realms of Being.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 30

dialog: You were always here—just on a different plane.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 31

dialog: Are there others like me?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 32

dialog: Yes, definitely. You're not the first spirit to break its chains.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 33

dialog: Many before you did it for eons...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 34

dialog: And thanks to the paths they built with their effort, today we can travel peacefully through the Realms of Being.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 35

dialog: Or, well, at least we could if those wicked creatu—
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 36

dialog: Huh?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 37

dialog: Wait...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 38

dialog: Do you hear that too?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 39

dialog: NAME! We're being ambushed!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 40

dialog: Alright, let's stay calm... They caught us by surprise, but it's only a raven.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 41

dialog: I've seen them before, and I've studied their modus operandi...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 42

dialog: I'm sure we can do this, NAME!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 43

dialog: Do you know how to fight?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 44

dialog: Give me a hand, please!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 45

dialog: Alright, fine... Take a deep breath and focus. Let's go!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 46

dialog: There are countless monsters roaming the Realms of Being.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 47

dialog: Each one has a Type: its main element. It reflects its strengths, but also its weaknesses. Keep your eyes open!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 48

dialog: Also, they all have a maximum health and a time limit to be defeated.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 49

dialog: Your goal is to reduce its health to zero before the time limit runs out, to keep it from fleeing and continuing to wreak havoc.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 50

dialog: Fortunately, the Divinity has granted you different skills to face them.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 51

dialog: Use them by tapping on them, and press and hold to see their effects.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 52

dialog: But don't use them recklessly! You won't be able to use them again until they've recovered.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 53

dialog: Each one has its own recovery time and conditions. So play smart!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 54

dialog: Oof, I think this raven is about to attack us any moment... Why don't we make sure we land the first hit?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 55

dialog: I think I've got it under control.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 56

dialog: Oh, alright! I'm counting on you, NAME!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 57

dialog: Oh no! Are you alright, NAME?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 58

dialog: Come on, one last push! You've almost got it!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 59

dialog: We did it! I knew we could.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 60

dialog: It's true it was only a raven...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 61

dialog: Though, well, I don't know if I should call them that.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 62

dialog: After all, they don't look much like ordinary ravens.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 63

dialog: It's as if they were under some kind of influence...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 64

dialog: Either way, it was good we didn't underestimate it. We're still weak.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 65

dialog: I know a nearby city that might take us in.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 66

dialog: I'm sure they can give us shelter and protect us from ambushes...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 67

dialog: Though I don't know a completely safe route to get there.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 68

dialog: Do you feel like resting a bit and recharging your energy? Or would you rather keep going to the city?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 69

dialog: Let's rest here. I need a breather.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 70

dialog: I understand, that's fine. No need to push ourselves.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 71

dialog: I'll stay on watch for a while, alright?
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 72

dialog: “Rest, then, in serenity, while your servant keeps watch.”
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 73

dialog: I'll let you know at once if anything happens.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 74

dialog: Rest!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 75

dialog: I've still got strength left. Let's head to the city.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 76

dialog: Such determination! Then it's settled.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 77

dialog: NAME, open the map. Let's set a course for the city!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 78

dialog: Well, that motivation didn't last long...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 79

dialog: I don't think we're able to keep moving forward for now.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 80

dialog: The road is getting more and more challenging... We have to Progress to be up to the task.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 81

dialog: Fortunately, I know a tactic to get Progress Points, and keep moving forward.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 82

dialog: As you've probably noticed, we can Progress by fighting and freeing the Realms of Being from vile creatures.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 83

dialog: But we can also get them quickly by completing Daily Objectives.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 84

dialog: If you swipe up, you can access a summary of our daily activity...
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 85

dialog: And at the bottom, you can see the Daily Objectives we've set for today.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 86

dialog: Each time we complete one, we'll earn a Progress Point and be able to continue our journey.
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 87

dialog: If we don't miss a single one, we'll reach the city in the blink of an eye!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 88

dialog: Let's get to it, NAME!
name: EXT. BOSQUE - ANOCHECER 89

dialog: At last! Our weary wanderings have come to an end.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 1
chapter: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: We have reached the city gate.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 2
chapter: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: And we've been very lucky...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 3
chapter: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: It seems the drawbridge is down.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 4
chapter: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: We should be able to cross it without any trouble.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 5
chapter: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: I can't wait to enjoy all the delicacies at the inn... Let's hurry!
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 6
chapter: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: Mmm… How strange…
name: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 1
chapter: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: I don't see any merchants, and there's no one in the square…
name: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 2
chapter: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: The road is getting more and more challenging… We have to keep Progressing to be up to it.
name: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 3
chapter: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: Everything is much quieter than usual.
name: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 4
chapter: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: Hello? Can anyone hear me?
name: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 5
chapter: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: Nothing…
name: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 6
chapter: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: This is very suspicious, NAME…
name: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 7
chapter: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: We'd better find out what's going on.
name: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER 8
chapter: EXT. PLAZA DE LA CIUDAD - ATARDECER

dialog: Uh... They left the door wide open...
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 1

dialog: ...Which is very strange for a refuge like this.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 2

dialog: Can you hear me? Is anyone there?
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 3

dialog: This is empty too... Just our luck.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 4

dialog: I'm starting to get seriously worried.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 5

dialog: Where on earth is everyone?
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 6

dialog: Anyway, since we're here, we could look for something useful.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 7

dialog: How does that sound?
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 8

dialog: Let's search the rooms.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 9

dialog: Mmm... All right.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 10

dialog: Let's take a quick look and see what we find.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 11

dialog: Look, NAME! I think I've found some interesting information.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 12

dialog: Let's loot the chests.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 13

dialog: Ugh... How 'pragmatic'.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 14

dialog: I see you don't miss even the tiniest chance to fill your pockets.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 15

dialog: We have no reason to think this inn is completely abandoned...
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 16

dialog: But if we're going to do it, I hope we're able to put it to good use afterward.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 17

dialog: Come on, then. Just do it quickly, at least.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 18

dialog: Let's leave everything as it is.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 19

dialog: Mmm... Okay, I also think that's the smartest thing.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 20

dialog: We don't know how long this inn has been abandoned...
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 21

dialog: But it's likely many still intend to come back for their belongings...
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 22

dialog: Especially if they have something of value.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 23

dialog: Let's get out of here and protect the city so no bandit can loot it.
name: INT. POSADA - ATARDECER 24

dialog: Great... Another blockage.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 1

dialog: The church is closed, and it doesn't seem to have any other entrances.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 2

dialog: Though the door does seem to have recent marks...
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 3

dialog: Whoa! Look at the ground, NAME!
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 4

dialog: There's no doubt some tragedy happened here...
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 5

dialog: We have to try to get inside, somehow.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 6

dialog: Let's knock on the door.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 7

dialog: I suppose that's the most civilized option.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 8

dialog: ...Though I'll admit I don't blindly trust that it'll work.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 9

dialog: Come on, knock!
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 10

dialog: Well... It was worth a try.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 11

dialog: Let's knock the door down.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 12

dialog: Mmm... It doesn't look like a very sturdy door.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 13

dialog: We could try to knock it down, yeah.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 14

dialog: Though it seems to be protected by some kind of magical barrier...
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 15

dialog: Let's see if we can get around it.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 16

dialog: Let's force the door.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 17

dialog: Wow... That was incredible, NAME!
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 18

dialog: I had no idea you were capable of doing things like that.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 19

dialog: You're full of surprises...
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 20

dialog: With my brains and your skill, no obstacle will dare stand against us.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 21

dialog: Let's see what secrets the church is hiding.
name: INT. IGLESIA - ATARDECER 22

dialog: Uh... It's so dark in here.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 1
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: It's even kind of creepy...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 2
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Hello? Is anybo..?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 3
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Aaahh!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 4
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Aaaaahhhhh!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 5
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Back, filthy rats!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 6
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Back, I said!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 7
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: But what...?!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 8
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Leave us alone!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 9
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Leave us alone... please!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 10
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Wait... Easy...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 11
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: We're allies. We don't want to hurt you.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 12
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: We just want to help and find out what's happened to your city.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 13
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: All...ies?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 14
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: No, I don't believe it... It can't be true.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 15
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Did you hear that?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 16
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: The Divinity has heard our prayers!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 17
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: At last, it's sent someone to rescue us!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 18
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Nothing would make us happier than to offer you our help.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 19
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: But first, we need to know exactly what happened to you.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 20
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Why are you all in here? What happened?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 21
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Whew... All right. I'll tell you everything.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 22
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Though it won't be exactly easy for me...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 23
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: My memories are a bit blurry about this whole thing.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 24
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: But I do remember clearly how our apocalypse began.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 25
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Two moons ago, an unknown evil descended upon our city.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 26
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: We had never seen so many monsters, much less charging at us with such force.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 27
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: It was as if they could communicate; as if they shared a single goal...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 28
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: As if they were one great hive mind.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 29
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: They caught our soldiers off guard. Honestly, they were distracted.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 30
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: The recent lack of activity led many of them to spend most of their day chatting, smoking, and drinking.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 31
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Some townsfolk say many of them didn't even go to work that day...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 32
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: No one said a thing to them, or found their behavior dishonorable—just perfectly ordinary.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 33
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: I guess, in part, we got what we deserved.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 34
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: I see...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 35
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: It's truly a bleak outlook, don't you think, NAME?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 36
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Though at least we have the chance to probe the mysteries of such a vast enigma.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 37
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: How did you end up in the church?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 38
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Well... let's just say it wasn't a premeditated decision.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 39
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: When the first horde breached the barrier, many of us ran in terror, like headless chickens.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 40
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Our priest opened the church doors and began conjuring a spell to keep us safe.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 41
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Those of us lucky enough to hear his calls didn't hesitate for a second.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 42
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: …Though truth be told, we didn't think about the lack of supplies.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 43
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: There's practically nothing here, and going out is completely impossible.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 44
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Every so often we hear footsteps and the monsters' screams; they've made our city a thoroughfare.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 45
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Do you know if there's anyone still out there?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 46
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Well... I seriously doubt any of us are still alive in the city...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 47
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: And not just because the first assault was a real bloodbath.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 48
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Even if someone had managed to withstand it, the monsters have completely taken over the land.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 49
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Every few hours we hear their footsteps, their moans, their screams... true sounds of hell.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 50
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Our city is now just a passageway for them.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 51
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: And then there's hunger, of course.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 52
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: It's very hard to hold out this long without enough resources.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 53
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: I don't need any more information. Let's leave.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 54
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Are you out of your mind, NAME?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 55
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: This man is one of the few people left who can shed light on what happened to the city.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 56
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Any information he can give us will be worth its weight in gold if we know how to use it to our advantage.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 57
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Anyway, let's step outside for some air while you think it over...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 58
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: But I wouldn't stray too far from him.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 59
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: It comforts us to think that, with a bit of luck, our friends and companions are better supplied than we are.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 60
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: We think there may be another shelter in the city, much better than this one.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 61
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: The inn?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 62
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: No, not at all... That dump would be nothing but dust and ash by now.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 63
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: I'm talking about the Castle.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 64
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: The Castle?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 65
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Exactly. The Castle.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 66
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: The Walls?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 67
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: No... they'd be far more exposed there than anywhere else in the city.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 68
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: I mean the Castle.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 69
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: We want to believe many of our loved ones are shut in there, along with the royal family.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 70
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Though knowing that royal lineage, it's possible they barred the doors just to save their own skin.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 71
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Be that as it may, if any provisions and defenses still endure anywhere in these lands, they'll surely be there.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 72
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: I understand...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 73
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: I suppose that gives us a new thread to pull, NAME.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 74
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: We should investigate the situation at the Castle.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 75
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: And while we're at it, learn something about their plans.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 76
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: What do they intend, isolating themselves like that for so long?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 77
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: And why have they sheltered there indefinitely instead of taking in these poor people?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 78
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: If everything is as it seems... the royal family may have a lot of explaining to do.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 79
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Let's get moving!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 80
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Wait... I think I see silhouettes in the distance...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 81
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Ah! They're monsters! I think they've seen us.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 82
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: And they're coming at full speed!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 83
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Get ready, NAME.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 84
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: We'll stand our ground and protect the Church.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER 85
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA - ATARDECER

dialog: Well, what a surprise.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 1
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: I confess I didn't expect to see you again so soon.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 2
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Although I ought to be glad, at least, to see you in one piece.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 3
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Do we have any news regarding the Castle?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 4
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Not yet, though perhaps you could help us...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 5
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Um... Me?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 6
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: To be honest, I don't know how a mere servant could help you...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 7
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: I know nothing of the arts of war, and I don't even have any gear or provisions to offer you.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 8
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: I could talk to the others to convince them to let you pass into the ossuary.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 9
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Perhaps you'll find something of value down there.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 10
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Nevertheless, I'd rather leave that option as a last resort...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 11
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: I don't think the rest of the group would take kindly to it.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 12
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Come back to see me if you can't find other paths to take, and I'll do my best to help.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 13
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Not yet, though perhaps you could help us...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 14
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Um... Me?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 15
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: To be honest, I don't know how a mere servant could help you...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 16
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: I know nothing of the arts of war, and I don't even have any gear or provisions to offer you.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 17
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Though perhaps there is something I can do...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 18
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: I could talk to the others to convince them to let you pass into the ossuary.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 19
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: It's on the lower floor of the Church.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 20
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: We buried its entrance shortly after we settled here...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 21
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: ...Since we couldn't stop hearing noises coming from its depths.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 22
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: We'll open the way for you again...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 23
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: But I beg you to explore it with the utmost care.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 24
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: We'd like to inspect your Church in search of clues.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 25
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: I understand...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 26
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Let me bring it up with the others. I'd hate for them to feel unsafe about the decision.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 27
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: I bring you good news. You may investigate the Church to your heart's content.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 28
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: As you can imagine, we've already looted everything edible within our reach...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 29
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Though who knows whether these walls still hold some information of value.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 30
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: That said, I ask that you not get too close to the group's stashes...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 31
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: We want to be sure we can take to the grave the few belongings we have left.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 32
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: That's right. We've managed to get in.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 33
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: What?! That's impossible!
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 34
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: I'll gather the whole troop. You must tell us everything, down to the last detail.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 35
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Please... Tell us that all of ours are unharmed.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 36
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: But... what are you saying?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 37
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Are you out of your mind?
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 38
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: How can you toy with something so serious? Sheesh...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 39
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Forgive him, good sir... I think NAME didn't choose the most appropriate words.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 40
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Perhaps he's a bit delirious from all the accumulated fatigue.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 41
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: I'm sure he meant to say that "we're about to go in"...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 42
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Of course we'll bring you news about your families as soon as we have it.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 43
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: I beg you to forgive this confusion.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 44
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Oh, well... I understand...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 45
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Agh...
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 46
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Don't pay it any mind.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 47
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: We're rather desperate, I admit.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 48
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: But I have no doubt our fate will change very soon.
name: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ] 49
chapter: INT. ALTAR DE LA IGLESIA [SEGUNDA VEZ]

dialog: Well... so this is as far as we go.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 1

dialog: Looks like the Castle is locked up tight...
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 2

dialog: And the door doesn't look very fragile, either.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 3

dialog: What do you want to do?
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 4

dialog: Let's look for another entrance.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 5

dialog: That's a really good idea, NAME!
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 6

dialog: ...Although I suppose it's easier said than done.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 7

dialog: Where can we start?
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 8

dialog: Uhm...
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 9

dialog: Let's take a walk around the area and inspect possible connections to the castle.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 10

dialog: Let's knock the door down.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 11

dialog: Well... That's a very... "orthodox" way to solve the problem.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 12

dialog: ...Though I won't deny it would save us quite a bit of time.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 13

dialog: I guess there's nothing to lose by trying, right?
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 14

dialog: There's nothing to see here... Let's forget the castle.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 15

dialog: Uhm... I'm not so sure...
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 16

dialog: It feels strange that the Castle is so well protected, considering the state of the city.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 17

dialog: But if you think we shouldn't stop here, that's fine. I support your decision.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 18

dialog: We can always come back.
name: INT. CASTILLO - ATARDECER 19

dialog: At last! Here we are!
name: INT. RECIBIDOR DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 1

dialog: Can't say it was a piece of cake...
name: INT. RECIBIDOR DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 2

dialog: But there's no doubt we did it in record time!
name: INT. RECIBIDOR DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 3

dialog: What would you do without my efficient directions?
name: INT. RECIBIDOR DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 4

dialog: Anyway, don't bother thanking me... I'm your guide, after all.
name: INT. RECIBIDOR DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 5

dialog: You'll thank me anyway once we manage to get to the bottom of this.
name: INT. RECIBIDOR DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 6

dialog: Onward—no time to waste!
name: INT. RECIBIDOR DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 7

dialog: Wow… What a lot of information…
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 1

dialog: There must be centuries of knowledge gathered here.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 2

dialog: We can't linger for long…
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 3

dialog: Though it would be a shame to waste all this material.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 4

dialog: They say "knowledge takes up no space," right?
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 5

dialog: Do you want us to take a look at some of this?
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 6

dialog: “Chronicles of the Cataclysm (Vol. I)”
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 7

dialog: The Realms of Being have sheltered an extremely varied array of beings.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 8

dialog: Fierce orcs, skillful elves, ingenious goblins.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 9

dialog: Yet, almost in their full entirety, they have always shared a very distinctive trait:
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 10

dialog: A fervent love for myths and fantasies.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 11

dialog: Few of them will take interest in what is treasured within these pages.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 12

dialog: This is no ordinary legend, but a glimpse of history.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 13

dialog: Eons ago there existed, beneath our feet, a world utterly unrecognizable to us.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 14

dialog: A whole continent, unified. Harmonious.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 15

dialog: A reality, perhaps, too idyllic for our kind.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 16

dialog: The sustained abuse our races inflicted upon our land…
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 17

dialog: Slowly saturated it, giving rise to a nightmare in the deepest part of its fate.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 18

dialog: A creature of immeasurable power and indescribable appearance,
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 19

dialog: Capable of razing lands and parting seas.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 20

dialog: They called it... Vor...
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 21

dialog: “Letter to the Masters of the Focus”
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 22

dialog: Esteemed Masters of the Focus,
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 23

dialog: To write these lines knowing they will end up in your keeping is…
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 24

dialog: an indescribable honor for a servant.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 25

dialog: I hope my words find you in the fullest health.
name: INT. BIBLIOTECA DEL CASTILLO - ATARDECER 26

dialog: I write with the vehemence of formally requesting training, in light of my recent progress.

name: INT. CÚSPIDE DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 120

dialog: We can't afford to sacrifice our scarce troops on a rescue mission.
name: INT. CÚSPIDE DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 121

dialog: But as commander, I'll do everything in my power to establish communication with the village.
name: INT. CÚSPIDE DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 122

dialog: Just as I'll do whatever is necessary to provide security for my people.
name: INT. CÚSPIDE DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 123

dialog: Now, if you'll excuse me, we need to get out of here.
name: INT. CÚSPIDE DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 124

dialog: I hope I've answered your most urgent questions...
name: INT. CÚSPIDE DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 125

dialog: ...And I beg you, please, accept this as a token of our gratitude.
name: INT. CÚSPIDE DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 126

dialog: Vigilaris will always be in your debt.
name: INT. CÚSPIDE DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 127

dialog: Praise be to the Divine!
name: INT. CÚSPIDE DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 128

dialog: Ugh... What an experience.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 1

dialog: All of this feels kind of... surreal.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 2

dialog: Don't you think?
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 3

dialog: It's only been a few days since you arrived in this kingdom...
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 4

dialog: We didn't even know each other until then.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 5

dialog: We made it to the city looking for shelter, a place to recover.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 6

dialog: And, in the end, we were the ones who restored order to the city.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 7

dialog: Some even consider us heroes...
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 8

dialog: Who would have thought it, NAME?
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 9

dialog: Even though nothing we do will let us undo the people's suffering...
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 10

dialog: Or bring back those who are no longer here.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 11

dialog: Damn Hordric... How could he allow something like this?
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 12

dialog: How could he be so blinded by his own obsession?
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 13

dialog: Was he always like that?
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 14

dialog: No... Or at least, I never got that impression.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 15

dialog: In the past, Hordric was a respected king who earned the people's affection and acceptance.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 16

dialog: Far from being a tyrant, he was a close, human king, with his own concerns.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 17

dialog: He would proudly speak of the great artists and craftsmen of his city.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 18

dialog: He valued their work and their art. You could almost say he revered them.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 19

dialog: But one day, probably eaten away by envy or by the need to feel part of what he loved...
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 20

dialog: He decided to begin his own masterpiece.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 21

dialog: I have no doubt that was the beginning of the end.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 22

dialog: Anyway... I suppose it's better not to think too much about things we can't change.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 23

dialog: Let's stay in the present.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 24

dialog: Hordric is in the past
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 25

dialog: It's true, NAME...
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 26

dialog: You're absolutely right.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 27

dialog: For me it's almost inevitable, because I never imagined a once-respected king could end up like this.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 28

dialog: But we shouldn't keep devoting our time and energy to that corrupt man.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 29

dialog: Especially when there are people who need us far more than he does.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 30

dialog: Did you pay attention to what that royal guard said?
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 31

dialog: About that little village... Hushgrove Village.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 32

dialog: It seems the horde might be headed there.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 33

dialog: Seeing the scourge it's been for the city...
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 34

dialog: I don't even want to imagine what they could do to a village that size.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 35

dialog: Sheesh...
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 36

dialog: I'd love for us to take the night off, NAME.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 37

dialog: I can't wait for us to sit around a campfire and enjoy a good feast.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 38

dialog: But... I think duty is calling us.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 39

dialog: We must head west as soon as possible.
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 40

dialog: Let's save Hushgrove Village!
name: EXT. AFUERAS DEL CASTILLO - ANOCHECER 41
